shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*'"\\.svg' -g '"'!*'"\\.png' -g '"'!*'"\\.jpg' -g '"'!*'"\\.woff*' -g '"'!*'"\\.jpeg' | head -70"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'navigation|table|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100 && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['uikit','table','navigation','icons']) {const j=require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,j.version,JSON.stringify(j.peerDependencies));}\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md | head -170 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -160 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/{table,navigation,uikit} | rg '(INDEX.md|AsideHeader.*d.ts|Table.*d.ts|useTable.*d.ts|use.*(Order|Group|Select).*d.ts|Select.*d.ts|Modal.*d.ts|TextInput.*d.ts|DropdownMenu.*d.ts)' | head -75 && curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && rg -o '\"(House|Persons|Bag|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|ChevronDown|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|Bars|Calendar|Funnel|LayoutColumns|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpRight|ArrowRightFromSquare|Grip|CircleCheck|CircleXmark|Clock)[A-Za-z]*\"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');for (const p of ['uikit','table','navigation','icons']) {const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json')); console.log(p,j.version,JSON.stringify(j.peerDependencies));}\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 70 '"'^#### Column reordering'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build | rg '(AsideHeader.*d.ts|types.d.ts|Logo.*d.ts)"'$'"' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -55 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(House|Persons|Bag|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|Chevron|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|Calendar|Funnel|LayoutColumns|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|CircleXmark|Clock|Ellipsis|Sliders|Bars|Receipt|Shop|ArrowRightFromSquare|ArrowsRotateRight|Layers|Envelope)' | head -60 && rg -n 'onUpdate|onChange|renderControl|startContent|endContent|pin|label|size|view' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Select/types,TextInput/TextInput,Modal/Modal,DropdownMenu/types}.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head -155 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -10 && rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/{AsideHeader,MenuItem}/*.css | sort -u | head -65 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '/(TextInput|Modal|DropdownMenu|Switch|Checkbox|Pagination|Popup|Avatar|Button)/.*(types|[A-Z][A-Za-z]+).d.ts"'$'"' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -105 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head -145 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -105 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'getIsGroupHeaderRow|renderGroupHeader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js && rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.js | sort -u && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|Bell|Calendar|ChevronDown|ChevronLeft|ChevronRight|ArrowsRotateRight|Xmark|Check|CreditCard|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|CircleXmark|Clock|ArrowRightFromSquare|Grip|Dots9|Bars|ArrowRight)\\.d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 1 'expanded-width|expandedWidth|ASIDE_HEADER_WIDTH|size:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/{AsideHeader.js,useAsideHeaderInnerContextValue.js,AsideHeaderContext.js,constants.js} && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -110 && rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderItem/*.css | sort -u | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts | head -75"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -105'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'expanded-width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader --glob '*.js' && rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderItem/*.css | sort -u | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"}).filter((o): o is Order => o "'!== null) : pageOrders", "}).filter(o => o !== null) : pageOrders")
s=s.replace("const statusIcons = {new: Clock, processing: Clock, completed: CircleCheck, cancelled: CircleXmark};'"\\n\", '')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js | head -150 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts | head -110 && rg -n -C 3 'renderGroupHeaderRowContent|getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js && cat index.html && cat vite.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.js | head -90 && rg -n -C 1 'ASIDE_HEADER_EXPANDED_WIDTH|ASIDE_HEADER_COMPACT_WIDTH' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/constants.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -125 && head -25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "head -100 node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseCell/BaseCell.js | head -85 && rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js && git status --short"
